tagline: A leading global electronic component technology distributor and solutions provider
hero_kpi_rationale: The Electronic Components segment represents 93.5% of total revenue, serving as the primary business driver and directly reflecting global demand for electronic components.

kpis.name: Electronic Components segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the distribution of electronic components (semiconductors, interconnects, etc.)
kpis.description: The EC segment revenue declined in 2025 due to lower demand and high inventory levels among customers.
kpis.signal: Core segment in sharp contraction due to the semiconductor cycle

kpis.name: Farnell segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Farnell segment, specialized in distributing components for engineers and startups
kpis.description: Farnell, focused on small customers and design, experienced a steeper decline than EC, reflecting reduced ongoing R&D projects.
kpis.signal: More pronounced slowdown than EC, indicating weakness in innovation and prototyping segments

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, indicating profitability on sales after cost of goods sold
kpis.description: Gross margin declined in 2025, impacted by volume pressure and product mix.
kpis.signal: Margin typical of a distributor, significantly lower than software or semiconductors

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.description: Operating margin fell by 123 basis points, linked to lower sales and restructuring costs.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in 2025, reflecting pressure on fixed costs during volume downturn

kpis.name: Adjusted operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin adjusted for exceptional items and amortization
kpis.description: Adjusted margin is higher than GAAP margin, but in continuous decline, showing persistent operational pressure.
kpis.signal: Key metric monitored by management to assess underlying operational performance

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total revenue of the company
kpis.description: Revenue declined by 6.6% in 2025, primarily due to weak demand in the West.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in 2025, aligned with the downturn cycle in the components sector

kpis.name: Restructuring costs
kpis.explanation: Expenses related to restructuring, integration, or other one-time actions
kpis.description: Restructuring costs increased significantly, reflecting rationalization efforts amid market slowdown.
kpis.signal: Restructuring costs doubled in 2025, indicating ongoing organizational adjustments

kpis.name: Asia sales growth
kpis.explanation: Sales growth in the Asia/Pacific region, year-on-year change
kpis.description: While sales declined in the Americas and EMEA, Asia posted 11.1% growth in 2025, becoming a growth pillar.
kpis.signal: Strong contrast with the West, signaling relocation or resilience in Asian demand

kpis.name: EMEA sales decline
kpis.explanation: Sales decline in the Europe, Middle East, Africa region
kpis.description: The EMEA region experienced a 23.7% drop in 2025, reflecting structural weakness in European industrial demand.
kpis.signal: Collapse in EMEA sales, more severe than elsewhere

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL data over the last 7 declared fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total Revenue of $22.201 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Technological change
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to technological changes, including artificial intelligence, which could reduce services required by customers. This could affect financial results.

risks.title: Supply chain disruption
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to supply chain disruptions, particularly due to fluctuations in semiconductor supply and demand, as confirmed in the 10-K.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, including phishing and ransomware attacks, which could negatively impact data and operations.

risks.title: Regulatory and trade risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory risks and changes in international trade policies, including tariffs and trade agreements.

risks.title: Dependence on information technology
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on its information technology for daily operations, making it vulnerable to system failures and disruptions.

risks.title: Geopolitical and trade risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical risks, including trade tensions, international conflicts, and changes in tariff policies that directly affect its operations and supply chain.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning was found in the provided text.
